cases.name: read-request-scope-from-field
cases.note: The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; a known property also matches its value rule, while an unknown one matches none (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies to it.

cases.name: read-request-scope-field-and-parameter
cases.note: Set by a field and by a custom parameter, even to the same value: unknown. The observer has one Allow rule per value and a catch-all; an unknown property matches no value rule (§applicability), so only the catch-all applies. Elevated, because a scope a custom parameter makes unknown is unreadable with NonElevated (§reading).
